name: Yellow Cottage (former site)
summary: The mapped cottage footprint appears as bare yard in the 2025 orthophoto.

evidence.note: City of London 2025 orthophoto. Bare yard continues through the red cottage outline. The silver arched shelter and rust-coloured shed lie primarily west of it and are recorded separately.
Inventory P50 0.84 m, P90 2.04 m, maximum 2.5 m. Median is 0.84 m and the maximum is only 2.5 m. There is no coherent pitched roof surface.
